description: The chart is a circular diagram divided into four main segments, each representing a different ethical principle: Justice, Beneficence, Autonomy, and Non-Maleficence. Each segment is further subdivided into various ethical considerations. The Justice segment includes considerations such as "Promote the Health of the Community" and "Treat Patients Fairly and Equally." The Beneficence segment includes "Provide Medical Care to Patients" and "Continual Learning." The Autonomy segment includes "Physician Can Freely Choose Whom to Serve" and "Professional Engagement with Patients and Their Relatives." The Non-Maleficence segment includes "Prevent Patient from Harm" and "Maintain Ethical and Unprofessional Conduct." The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any slices that are visually emphasized. The segments are ordered in a way that the main ethical principles are at the center, with their respective considerations radiating outward.
